: Ferrari (RACE) buyback: Jan 5–Sep 25, 2026 spent €57.46M on 160,799 shares (Euronext) and $21.999M on 53,790 (NYSE). Treasury: 1,805,393 shares (1.02%).
: Goldman Sachs reiterated Buy on Ferrari NV (RACE), raised its price target, forecasts Q3 deliveries slightly below consensus but expects Q3 revenue and EBIT above Street estimates.
Deutsche Bank Sees Strong Cash Flow
: Deutsche Bank sees Ferrari (RACE) posting strong cash flow from solid earnings, limited working-capital use, favorable pricing and mix, F80 ramp, 296 Speciale launch; shares up 1.8% to €354.10.
: Goldman sees Ferrari (RACE) average selling prices pre-currency at €456,000 in Q3 and €461,000 in Q4, assuming deliveries of F80, 849 Testarossa and 296 VS and personalization above 20%.
: Analysts forecast Ferrari (RACE) special-series volumes at 2,540 in 2026 and 2,480 in 2027, above prior consensus, while cutting 2024 Luce deliveries to 150 and slowing Amalfi ramp-up.
